subject: Mutual action roadmap — gated dataset & prompt-pack exchange and close timeline
messages:
From: Sophie Marshall <sophie@cascadeai.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation collaboration — dataset and prompt-pack exchange

Hi Naomi + Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week — excited by the latency/cost profile you showed. We want to move towards a short mutual-action roadmap so our ML team can evaluate Redwood on real workloads. Key asks from our side:

- We need an evaluation dataset (approx 10k queries + labels) and a prompt-pack containing 75 test cases that reflect our user intents.
- Usage constraints: dataset must be ephemeral for 90 days, no downstream commercial reuse, and the testcases must not be redistributed outside our evaluation team.
- Security: we need to confirm how audit logs and request traces will be handled for the trial.

Are you able to provide a draft MAP and an approximate close timeline (targeting a purchase decision by the end of May)? Also, procurement may want a simple SLA for trial uptime + an indication of deployment mode (hosted vs dedicated).

Thanks — I can loop in procurement if needed.

Sophie
Sophie Marshall
Head of ML Ops, Cascade AI

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Marshall <sophie@cascadeai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation collaboration — dataset and prompt-pack exchange

Sophie — thanks for the clear ask and for the time last week. Attaching a draft mutual action roadmap that maps deliverables, dates, and the gating language you requested (see attachment: NAOMI_MAP_v1.pdf). High-level plan below and a couple of clarifying questions:

High-level MAP (draft)
- Week 0 (kickoff): access JS + onboarding notebook; sign mutual-use addendum.
- Week 1–2: Redwood provides prompt-pack (75 cases) and sample dataset subset (1k queries) for quick smoke tests.
- Week 3–4: Full evaluation dataset (10k queries + labels) provisioned into an ephemeral evaluation sandbox.
- Day 30: Quality sign-off milestone; start of 60-day performance monitoring window.
- Day 90: Data takedown and verification; decision checkpoint.

Clarifying Qs 
1) For the 90-day ephemeral constraint — do you need air-gapped access/on-prem runner, or will hosted ephemeral access (VPC-proxied) suffice?
2) For the non-commercial use clause, would a short MPA (mutual prompt agreement) be acceptable, or do you need a redline-ready contract for your legal team?

Security note: we will provide request-level audit logs and a scoped CSV export for the eval; access is limited to named Cascade engineers. Karthik is on cc and will add the technical gating language.

Next steps: I can turn the attachment into a two-column mutual-action checklist (deliverable / acceptance criteria) and circulate for signature once we align on the gating bullets.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Customer Success — Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Marshall <sophie@cascadeai.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation collaboration — dataset and prompt-pack exchange

Sophie / Naomi — quick technical additions from infra/security: 

- Ephemeral sandbox: we can provision a VPC-proxied evaluation sandbox with per-user keys; data stored on ephemeral volumes and scheduled for automated destruction on Day 91.
- Access controls: named-user IAM + short-lived tokens; we require a single point of contact list for allowed Cascade engineers.
- Hashing and redaction: we can accept hashed identifiers (we recommend SHA-256) for PII-sensitive fields; we do not persist raw identifiers in the audit exports.
- Audit logs: we supply request-level traces (timestamp, model, route, token counts, request-id) in CSV. If you need SSA-style logs, that will require an addendum and a scoped retention window.

Operational gating (suggested wording to include in MAP): 
- "Redwood will provision an ephemeral evaluation sandbox with named-user access and automated takedown on Day 91. Audit exports restricted to named Cascade engineers; no downstream reuse permitted. Any extended retention requires prior written agreement."

Happy to walk through the technical checklist over a 30-min call.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Platform Reliability

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Marshall <sophie@cascadeai.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 08:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation collaboration — dataset and prompt-pack exchange

Following up with a proposed operational close timeline and milestone owners (attached: ops_timeline.xlsx). Key items: 

- 2027-05-10: Kickoff + names for access (Cascade to provide SSO list). Owner: Naomi.
- 2027-05-12: Prompt-pack delivery (75 cases). Owner: Redwood — Marissa.
- 2027-05-19: Full dataset ingestion into sandbox (10k queries + labels). Owner: Redwood — Marissa + infra.
- 2027-05-26: Quality sign-off (Cascade ML lead). Owner: Cascade; Redwood to provide evaluation report.
- 2027-05-31: Procurement close target; PO or signed agreement in place.

Notes and constraints: 
- Attachment handling: prompt-pack delivered as zipped testcases; dataset provided as encrypted CSV and only made available within the sandbox (no external download).
- Verification: Redwood will provide an automated takedown report showing volume deleted and hash of the deleted files for your records.

Please confirm if the May 31 procurement target works for your team; if procurement needs longer we can push the timeline but prefer to lock acceptance criteria now so engineering can schedule resources.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Sophie Marshall <sophie@cascadeai.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@cascadeai.com
Date: Mon, 9 May 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation collaboration — dataset and prompt-pack exchange

Thanks all — this is great and aligns with our expectations. A few quick items from procurement before we sign: 

1) Can you convert the MAP draft into a 1-page execution checklist we can attach to our PO (procurement asked for a single reference doc)?
2) Procurement requested a short cancellation clause for the sandbox ("48 hours notice for termination during evaluation") — open to that?
3) Please include the DocuSign link for the mutual-use addendum when you circulate the final checklist.

We will provide the named SSO list by EOD Tuesday. Procurement copied here — feel free to send the PO-ready checklist and the DocuSign link.

Approved for next step from ML: proceed to prompt-pack delivery on 2027-05-12.

Best,
Sophie
